title: Betulinic acid is associated with miR-21 modulation, apoptosis and redox changes in breast cancer cells: an in vitro and in silico study.
authors: Mahmoud, Mohammad A; Abdo, Hagar; Mekky, Mariam; Salem, Tasneem; Mabrouk, Sara; Khaled, Basmala
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨桦木酸对乳腺癌细胞的凋亡及miR-21调控作用，仅含少量分子对接，但核心为细胞实验与表达分析，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Betulinic acid is defined as a hydrophobic pentacyclic triterpenoid primarily found in the bark of Betula alba, known for its anticancer activity through mechanisms such as upregulating proapoptotic proteins, modulating NF-kB, and inhibiting topoisomerase I. The current study aimed to explore the anticancer potential effect, molecular targets, and association with miR-21 modulation after BA treatment and its combination with doxorubicin against human triple-negative breast cancer (MDA-MB-231) cells. We determined drug cytotoxicity by MTT assay, and death mechanism by flow cytometry. Besides, the potential effect of BA and DOX treatment on downstream effect of miR-21 on HIF1A, PDCD4, PTEN and SMAD7 expression levels. Finally, a molecular docking study was performed to determine molecular targets, binding affinity, and mode of interactions of BA and DOX with HIF1A, PDCD4, PTEN and SMAD7. Collectively, our data showed that treatment with BA and/or DOX have significantly describing observed differences under the tested conditions associated with increasing apoptosis, downregulation of miR-21, HIF1A and SMAD7 expression and upregulation of PDCD4 and PTEN. Finally, the molecular docking study suggested potential interactions between BA and DOX with PTEN and PDCD4, modulating their activities leading to growth arrest and cell death. In conclusion, this study reported BA as potential antiproliferative compound with modulation of miR-21 expression and identified molecular targets involved in its action.
abstract_zh: 白桦脂酸被定义为一种疏水性五环三萜类化合物，主要存在于白桦（Betula alba）树皮中，以其通过上调促凋亡蛋白、调节NF-kB及抑制拓扑异构酶I等机制展现的抗癌活性而闻名。本研究旨在探讨白桦脂酸（BA）处理及其与多柔比星（DOX）联合使用对人三阴性乳腺癌（MDA-MB-231）细胞的抗癌潜力效应、分子靶点及其与miR-21调节的关联。我们通过MTT法测定药物细胞毒性，并通过流式细胞术分析死亡机制。此外，研究了BA和DOX处理对miR-21下游效应因子HIF1A、PDCD4、PTEN和SMAD7表达水平的潜在影响。最后，进行了分子对接研究，以确定BA和DOX与HIF1A、PDCD4、PTEN和SMAD7的分子靶点、结合亲和力及相互作用模式。总体而言，我们的数据表明，BA和/或DOX处理在测试条件下显著描述了观察到的差异，与凋亡增加、miR-21、HIF1A和SMAD7表达下调以及PDCD4和PTEN表达上调相关。最后，分子对接研究提示BA和DOX与PTEN和PDCD4之间存在潜在相互作用，调节其活性，导致生长停滞和细胞死亡。总之，本研究报道了BA作为一种具有调节miR-21表达潜力的抗增殖化合物，并鉴定了其作用中涉及的分子靶点。
